knownCorrectionsAndPolicies.scope: Edge of Breakdown English behavior text
knownCorrectionsAndPolicies.reason: The Java implementation applies FrailPower and the Simplified Chinese source says 脆弱, so the English source text is incorrect.
STS2 renamed and revised the corresponding native base-game power; the port uses PlatingPower and its current localized title.
The displayed value is calculated from base Block plus floor(Dazzling / 2), while deliberately bypassing Dexterity.
